scholarships.title: DOST-SEI Foreign Graduate Scholarships in Specialized Priority Fields in Science and Technology (Philippines)
scholarships.official_source: Department of Science and Technology - Science Education Institute (DOST-SEI), Philippines

eligibility: Not more than 50 years old at the time of application
In the first five years of their research career
A permanent or regular employee of a private or government institution or office in the Philippines
Endorsed by the Head of the Sending Institution or Office
Must pass the admission requirements of the foreign university for graduate studies
Must pass the interview and other screening procedures
Must have a research interest aligned with the areas under DOST's Harmonized National Research and Development Agenda (HNRDA)
Must have a viable re-entry plan
Must not have availed of or be enjoying any other scholarship
benefits: Maximum allotted budget of PHP 3,000,000.00 per scholar per academic year
coverage: Maximum allotted budget of PHP 3,000,000.00 per scholar per academic year
requirements: Must undertake the MS or PhD programme full-time, for a maximum of 24 or 36 months respectively
Must not be a lateral entrant
Must make a full-time commitment to the scholarship and not engage in any form of employment during the scholarship period
Must submit an advance copy of the application to fgs@sei.dost.gov.ph
Must submit original documents to DOST-SEI at the Science Heritage Building, DOST Compound, Bicutan, Taguig City
documents: Certified True Copy of Official Transcript of Records
Endorsement from two former college professors for MS applicants, or two professors from the MS programme for PhD applicants
Recommendation from the Head of the Sending Institution or Office
Permission to take a leave of absence while on scholarship
Medical Certificate as to health status and fitness to study from a licensed physician with PRC license number indicated
Letter of Admission to the foreign university
Budgetary Requirements with supporting documents for the bases of rates used
application_method: Download the application form and documentary requirements checklist from the official DOST-SEI site
Email an advance copy of the complete application to fgs@sei.dost.gov.ph before the applicable filing deadline
Submit the original documents to DOST-SEI at the Science Heritage Building, DOST Compound, Bicutan, Taguig City

Undergo first-level documentary screening, second-level evaluation of the research topic and re-entry plan by the concerned DOST Council, and a third-level panel interview convened by the SEI Director
existing.selection_notes: Three-stage selection: first-level documentary evaluation of the application form and requirements; second-level evaluation of the research topic and re-entry plan by the concerned DOST Council; third-level interview by a panel created by the SEI Director. Results are announced in December for the January to July intake and in July for the August to December intake.
existing.notes: The France Excellence-DOST sub-programme is the successor to the PhilFrance-DOST Fellowship and targets students admitted to a French programme issuing a diplome national at M1, M2 or doctorate level.
existing.duration: Full-time MS for a maximum of 24 months or PhD for a maximum of 36 months; no lateral entrants are considered.
existing.application_period: Two intakes a year. January to July intake: file by 15 August, panel interview in October, results in December. August to December intake: file by 15 March, panel interview in May, results in July.
existing.deadline_display: Next filing deadline 15 March (August to December intake); the other annual deadline is 15 August
